report_treatment: Only bounded local documentary comparisons are presented; no analytic wage-gap estimate is reported.
The evidence identifies plausible mechanisms but does not establish treatment effects or causal effects.
The processed corpus is not treated as a representative probability sample of municipalities.
No regression or treatment-effect model was run.
COLA/CPI appears only as source-reported contract language; no analyst-side COL adjustment was made.
601 retained sources remain deferred for OCR and are outside this report's evidence base.
Rank, tenure, step, duties, hours, and qualifications remain unresolved in many candidate comparisons.
Many quantitative records remain partial, mechanism-only, deferred, or unusable for wage-level comparison.
Even the cleanest local comparison needs final substantive review before analytic use.
Search, reachability, retention, extraction, rating, and normalization gates shape the observed evidence.
